India wins Lord's Test, loses T20 series

India secured a significant victory in the one-off Test match against England at Lord's, with Kranti Gaud's bowling performance and Smriti Mandhana's batting contributing to a first-innings lead. Separately, India's men's T20 team suffered a series loss to England, marking the end of a long unbeaten streak in T20I series.
